mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `repair`(student_id, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES( #{userId}, #{description}, CASE #{status} WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 2 WHEN 'FINISHED' THEN 3 WHEN 'CANCELED' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, description, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN 3 THEN 'FINISHED' WHEN 4 THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, create_time, update_time FROM `repair` WHERE student_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, student_id, description, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN 3 THEN 'FINISHED' WHEN 4 THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, create_time, update_time FROM `repair` ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, student_id, description, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN 3 THEN 'FINISHED' WHEN 4 THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, create_time, update_time FROM `repair` WHERE status = CASE #{status} WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 2 WHEN 'FINISHED' THEN 3 WHEN 'CANCELED' THEN 4 ELSE -1 END ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, student_id, description, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN 3 THEN 'FINISHED' WHEN 4 THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, create_time, update_time FROM `repair` WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `repair` r INNER JOIN `user` u ON r.student_id = CAST(u.id AS CHAR) WHERE r.student_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
mapper.update: UPDATE `repair` r INNER JOIN `user` u ON r.student_id = CAST(u.id AS CHAR) SET r.student_id = u.account WHERE r.student_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `repair` r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.student_id = u.account WHERE u.account IS NULL
